name: Budget
description: What you spend this month, by category, against your own budget. Never leaves this phone.
schema: CREATE TABLE expenses (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), amount REAL NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT, at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
CREATE TABLE prefs (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO expenses (amount, category, note, at) VALUES (64.30, 'Groceries', 'Weekly shop', datetime('now', '-1 hours')), (12.90, 'Eating out', 'Lunch with Sam', datetime('now', '-1 days')), (49.00, 'Transport', 'Monthly ticket', datetime('now', '-1 days', '-2 hours')), (23.50, 'Fun', 'Cinema', datetime('now', '-2 days')), (8.40, 'Groceries', 'Bakery', datetime('now', '-3 days')), (89.99, 'Home', 'Desk lamp', datetime('now', '-4 days')), (31.20, 'Eating out', 'Pizza night', datetime('now', '-5 days')), (41.75, 'Groceries', 'Market', datetime('now', '-6 days'))

card.query: SELECT printf('€%.0f', spent) AS spent, top, printf('€%.0f', max(budget - spent, 0)) AS left, CAST(round(100.0 * spent / max(budget, 1)) AS INTEGER) AS pct FROM (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) AS spent, (SELECT category FROM expenses WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', at, 'localtime') = strftime('%Y-%m', 'now', 'localtime') GROUP BY category ORDER BY sum(amount) DESC LIMIT 1) AS top, (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM prefs WHERE key = 'budget') AS budget FROM expenses WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', at, 'localtime') = strftime('%Y-%m', 'now', 'localtime'))
card.chart: WITH RECURSIVE d(n) AS (SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT n - 1 FROM d WHERE n > 0) SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) FROM expenses WHERE date(at, 'localtime') = date('now', 'localtime', '-' || d.n || ' days')) AS spent FROM d

widget.query: SELECT printf('€%.0f', spent) AS spent, printf('€%.0f', max(budget - spent, 0)) AS left, round(min(1.0, spent / max(budget, 1)), 2) AS ratio, CAST(round(100.0 * spent / max(budget, 1)) AS INTEGER) AS pct FROM (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) AS spent, (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM prefs WHERE key = 'budget') AS budget FROM expenses WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', at, 'localtime') = strftime('%Y-%m', 'now', 'localtime'))

children.query: WITH RECURSIVE d(n) AS (SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT n - 1 FROM d WHERE n > 0) SELECT strftime('%d', 'now', 'localtime', '-' || n || ' days') AS label, (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) FROM expenses WHERE date(at, 'localtime') = date('now', 'localtime', '-' || d.n || ' days')) AS value FROM d
